summary: Backend (4/4 pytest pass): checklist template create with kind/checklist_items/target_percent, submission with HL29_EXT etc., GET /forms/templates/{id}/stats returns overall_done/overall_possible/overall_percent/on_target/per-item EXT/INT counts correctly, date_from/date_to filter works, regular 'form' kind still works. Frontend: CRITICAL red-screen 'ReferenceError: fKind is not defined' at admin.tsx because ~10 useState declarations were missing (fKind/setFKind, fTarget, items, bulkInput, subKeysInput, allTemplates, statsTpl, stats, statsBusy, statsRange). Fixed by adding the missing useState hooks. After fix and metro restart with cache clear: Admin → Forms tab loads, Create Form/Checklist modal opens, kind toggle works, bulk-add appends items, Publish creates template, Stats button opens stats modal with overall %, per-item EXT/INT counts and Day/Week/Month/All filters. End-to-end checklist UI flow verified.
action_items: Verify the fix to admin.tsx (added missing useState declarations) is acceptable. The original commit was missing: fKind, fTarget, items, bulkInput, subKeysInput, allTemplates, statsTpl, stats, statsBusy, statsRange.
Recommend adding TypeScript strict-mode + tsc --noEmit pre-commit check; Metro/Babel strips TS so undeclared identifiers slip through bundling and only fail at runtime.

Forms tab card on the staff-facing Forms screen still shows '{t.fields?.length || 0} fields' for checklist templates — should show item count + target % (matches admin card) for clearer staff context.
admin.tsx is now ~735 lines — at the >700 split-threshold; consider extracting FormBuilder + Stats modals into separate components.
critical_code_review_comments: Stats endpoint correctly accumulates per_item/sub_key counts and filters by created_at date range; date_to is inclusive +1 day which is correct.
Checklist submission values use composite keys f'{item_id}_{sub_key}' matching frontend cb-{key} testIDs.
load() in admin.tsx wraps in try/catch{} that silently swallows errors — adding even a console.warn would have surfaced the ReferenceError much earlier.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_TruckWash checklist (3 items × EXT/INT, target 100), TEST_RegularForm, plus one staff submission. Frontend test created UI_TruckWash checklist (4 items). All prefixed for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metro runs in CI mode (reloads disabled). After editing /app/frontend/app/*.tsx you MUST 'rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo' and wait ~40s for re-bundle, otherwise stale bundle is served. Use BASE = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Tests: pytest backend/tests/test_checklist.py + test_staffhub_api.py. The new checklist testIDs: kind-form, kind-checklist, checklist-subkeys, checklist-target, checklist-bulk, checklist-bulk-add, publish-template, stats-{tplId}, range-day/week/month/all, cb-{HLxx}_{EXT|INT}, checklist-date, checklist-notes, submit-form.
rca_of_issue: Bug: Admin Panel red-screened with 'ReferenceError: fKind is not defined'. Reproduction: login as admin → Profile → Admin Panel → renders Holidays fine, but on first render JSX references many undefined identifiers. Root cause: developer added new state variables for the checklist form-builder + stats modal but forgot to declare them via useState. Because Metro/Babel only strip TypeScript without type-checking, the undefined-identifier bugs were not surfaced at bundle time. Fix: added the 10 missing useState declarations in admin.tsx in the same block as existing form-modal state. Verified post-fix: no pageerrors, full checklist publish + stats flow works.
